data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order (Book > Hotels, destination, dates, Search, guests, filters/sort, reserve) and names the right parameters, but it describes the Booking.com partner page in more detail than the true workflow and splits guests into separate adults, children and rooms parameters.
